headline: Check Local Access for the Jurassic Coast
reservation: While entry to the National Landscape is generally open, specific heritage sites or parking areas along the Jurassic Coast may require separate fees or seasonal booking. Always verify current access status with local site managers as geological stability can impact coastal paths.
